actual: Before start 400; after start 200; prescription "Paracetamol 500mg"; patient notified true

objective: Only a doctor can write a prescription

actual: Status 400: "Only a doctor can write a prescription."

expected: 200, slot gone, notice "Appointment cancelled"; then 400 "already cancelled"

expected: Ayesha Khan and Bilal Ahmed only; search gives Bilal; member gets 403

objective: A nutritionist saves a diet plan that is stored with its author and announced to the patient
input: PUT /api/patients/pat1/plans/diet with 1900 kcal, 120/210/60 g
expected: 200; stored target 1900 with author Sara Khan (nutritionist); patient notified; visible on the record
actual: Status 200; stored target 1900; author Sara Khan (nutritionist); notice "Your diet plan was updated"; record shows 1900

objective: Diet plan numbers are checked and each problem is explained
input: Targets 300 and 6000 kcal; macros that do not add up to 1900; only some macros; an unknown status; an empty change
expected: Each refused with 400 and a clear message
actual: 400 "The calorie target must be a whole number from 800 to 5000." | 400 "The calorie target must be a whole number from 800 to 5000." | 400 "Protein, carbohydrate and fat add up to about 4100 kcal, which differs from the 1900 kcal target by more than 15%. Check the numbers." | 400 "Give protein, carbohydrate and fat together, or none of them." | 400 "Choose "Approve as is" or "Save changes"." | 400 "Change at least one thing, or choose "Approve as is"."

objective: A trainer builds a workout plan from the exercise library only and the schedule is validated
input: Valid 7-day plan; then a plan with an invented exercise, 6 days, no sets, and a workout on a rest day
expected: Valid plan 200 and stored; each bad plan 400
actual: Valid plan 200, 7 days stored; bad plans: 400 "The schedule needs all seven days." | 400 ""made_up_move" is not an exercise in the Baymax library." | 400 "Sets for Sit-to-Stand (Chair Squat) must be a whole number from 1 to 8." | 400 "A rest day cannot have exercises."

objective: A specialist can remove their plan and the patient is told Baymax's plan applies again
input: Nutritionist sets and then deletes the diet plan; a trainer tries to delete; delete again
expected: Trainer 403; nutritionist 200 and plan gone; patient notified "back to Baymax"; second delete 404
actual: Trainer 403; nutritionist 200; plan gone true; patient told true; second delete 404

objective: A nutritionist approves or flags a day of the shared food log, and a flag needs a reason
input: PUT diet-reviews: approve 2026-10-19; flag 2026-10-18 with a note; flag without a note
expected: 200, 200 with the patient told "flagged", then 400 "why you are flagging"
actual: Approve 200; flag 200, patient told true; flag without reason 400 "Say why you are flagging this day, so the patient knows what to change."

objective: Registering as a specialist stores a pending application and grants nothing

expected: 201 pending; email taken from the account; no role; not listed; licence number not echoed back
actual: Status 201 (pending); stored email newbie@example.com; role undefined; listed false; role seen by the app user

objective: The licence number is required and the form is checked
input: Registration without a licence number; with a bad type; with a negative fee
actual: 400 "Enter your professional licence or registration number (3 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, - . /)." | 400 "Type must be one of: doctor, nutritionist, trainer." | 400 "Fees must be whole numbers of PKR between 0 and 1,000,000."

objective: An administrator approves an application: role, verified public profile, and the specialist can sign in

actual: Admin sees licence "PMDC-12345"; approve 200; role doctor; verified true; licence published false; new specialist dashboard 200; second approval 409

objective: Rejecting an application records the reason and never creates a role

actual: Long reason 400; reject 200; status rejected; role undefined

objective: Only an administrator reaches the admin routes

objective: An administrator adds a specialist without ever setting a password

expected: 201; account created without a password; role and profile set; a link to choose a password is returned
actual: Status 201; created true; role doctor; link returned true

objective: Closing an account needs the word DELETE and a recent sign-in

objective: Closing a specialist account cancels future bookings, frees the times, tells patients and keeps past records
